title: Residential Natural Gas Supply Billing Service Standard — Late-Posted Loyalty Credits
content:
**Standard.** The late-posting supplement of a Residential Natural Gas Supply renewal loyalty credit depends on the whole calendar months from the renewal's plan change date to the posting date: when there are 9 or more, it accrues 2.00 for each of those whole months; when there are at least 3 but fewer than 9, it is the flat amount 5.00; when there are fewer than 3, there is no supplement. The supplement, in US dollars, is added to the renewal loyalty credit owed.

A whole calendar month is completed when the posting date reaches the same day of the month as the plan change date.

| Whole calendar months from the plan change date to the posting date | Late-posting supplement |
|---|---|
| 9 or more | 2.00 for each whole month |
| 3 to 8 | 5.00 flat |
| 0 to 2 | none |

### Worked cases (hypothetical plan change date 15 January)

| Posting date | Whole months | Supplement |
|---|---|---|
| 14 April | 2 | none |
| 15 April | 3 | 5.00 |
| 14 October | 8 | 5.00 |
| 15 October | 9 | 9 multiplied by 2.00 is 18.00 |
| 15 November | 10 | 10 multiplied by 2.00 is 20.00 |
